ut.scope: Full flexlb-api reactor including sync/common/cache/grpc; mock-engine BlockPoolCapacityTest and JavaMockEngineClusterTest

performance_reproduction.order: latest then baseline, reverse of initial order
performance_reproduction.initial_latest_failure: BATCH 10k client_qps=9694; NON_BATCH 10k route_submit_p99=326ms, master_p99=334ms, client_p99=344.733ms
performance_reproduction.diagnostic: NON_BATCH 10k master/client P99=4/21.562ms; initial routing stall not reproduced. BATCH JFR measured GC max 92.453ms and client P99=66.431ms. No claim of root cause for the initial unrecorded stall.

implemented: VictimResolution explicitly separates REQUEST_END and DELIVERY_RESUMED at original notification sites.
Context exclusively mutates nested PreemptionRegistration under its request monitor.
DecodeCapacityAcquirer replaces Manager and Coordinator; cancel ACK and completion budgets remain separate.
One commit/submitRoute flow consumes ordinary admission and local/remote replacement results.
Prefill victim policy is pure; State retains exact queue identity, capacity and atomic replacement.
Decode snapshot and redundant branches simplified without deleting independent facts or incremental caches.
equivalence_coverage: RequestTerminalSettlementTest: deferred terminal, delivery ACK during preemption, cleanup capacity publication outside Context lock.
GlobalQueueProgressTest: local/remote completion, failure quota return, exact late reservation rollback and requeue.
DecodeCapacityAcquirerProtocolTest: NOT_FOUND, REQUEST_FENCED versus REQUEST_CLEANED, ACK budget and late request resolution.
DeliverySettlementTest and SubmissionShutdownDeadlockTest: uncertain send, late ACK, cleanup and shutdown.
Existing Prefill/Decode ledger and priority tests: exact identity, FIFO tie order, insufficient capacity and conserved usage.

decode_ledger_audit.decodeRequests: Actual generation-scoped resource ownership and exact reservation token.
decode_ledger_audit.settledHistory: Prevents late WorkerStatus from recreating already settled resources.
decode_ledger_audit.reservedUsage/queuedUsage/dispatchUsage: Different occupancy dimensions, incrementally updated under the single admission lock.
decode_ledger_audit.confirmedEngineOwnedCount: Engine-confirmed occupancy, including observations without local request ownership.
decode_ledger_audit.victimClaims/preemptionAttempts: Victim holds and incoming multi-victim transactions have different lifetime and identities.
decode_ledger_audit.priorityPreemptionHeldKv/priorityPreempt: Retained capacity during uncertain cancellation after worker-side release.
decode_ledger_audit.nextReservationToken: Fences stale reservation operations within this generation.
decode_ledger_audit.admissionVersion/routingViewCache/admiss: Avoids routing-time full-table scans; includes WorkerStatus and topology identity.
decode_ledger_audit.DecodeRequestState: Hard/expected KV, original priority, exact token, ownership phase, observation time and exact dispatch permit are independent facts.

review.scope: Context, Scheduler, result semantics and notification order
review.applied: Reconciliation method renamed to cover resumed delivery; duplicate terminal retention removed.

review.scope: Merged service, commit flow, ownership transfer, cancel windows and locking
review.applied: Unused imports and constructor-proven redundant null check removed.

review.scope: State policy separation, ledger fields, locks and runner fixture follow-up
review.applied: Mutable candidate-buffer contract documented; empty runner fixture uses a real empty repository.

verification_failures_and_repairs: Spring lazy proxy could not subclass final service; final removed and assembly regression passed.
Isolated snapshot initially omitted external proto/telemetry fixtures; supplied unchanged tracked inputs.
Rename missed one assembly reference; corrected before final compilation.
Runner shared mock created unused, fictitious request stubs depending on test order; replaced with an empty real RequestRepository without relaxing assertions.

baseline.run-perf.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/flexlb-jdk21-20261002
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export MAVEN_OPTS="-Duser.home=/data0/luoli.hn/data0 -Dmaven.repo.local=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/.m2/repository"
cd /data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-capacity-convergence-20261008/baseline/rtp_llm/flexlb
out=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-capacity-convergence-20261008/baseline/evidence/perf-final
mkdir -p "$out"
export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=$out/gc-%p.log:time,uptimemillis,level,tags"
{ date -Iseconds; uname -a; java -version; getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN; free -g; uptime; } > "$out/environment.txt" 2>&1
status=0
for mode in BATCH NON_BATCH; do
 decision=FIXED_WINDOW
 if [ "$mode" = NON_BATCH ]; then decision=SINGLE; fi
 set +e
 timeout --kill-after=15s 900s ./mvnw -B -P 'opensource,!internal,api-performance-regression' -pl flexlb-api -am \
 '-Dtest=MasterBatchEndToEndPerformanceTest#masterMeetsRateSloAcrossEngineScaleMatrix' \
 -DfailIfNoTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
 -Dflexlb.perf.heap=64g "-Dflexlb.perf.delivery-mode=$mode" "-Dflexlb.perf.decision-mode=$decision" \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-topologies=750x750 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-target-qps=3000,10000 \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-duration-ms=10000 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-ms=10000 \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-requests-per-prefill=16 \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-min-qps-ratio=0.98 \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-server-p99-ms=50 \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-client-p99-ms=50 \
 -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-batch-wait-p99-ms=50 \
 test > "$out/$mode.log" 2>&1
 result=$?
 set -e
 echo "$result" > "$out/$mode.exit"
 if [ "$result" -ne 0 ]; then status=1; fi
 report=flexlb-api/target/surefire-reports/TEST-org.flexlb.httpserver.MasterBatchEndToEndPerformanceTest.xml
 if [ -f "$report" ]; then cp "$report" "$out/$mode.xml"; fi
 awk '/FlexLB offered traffic:|FlexLB client latency:|FlexLB Master engine-scale E2E:|\[ERROR\]|BUILD SUCCESS|BUILD FAILURE/' "$out/$mode.log"
done
exit "$status"
